page.overview:
Who is Gretta?

Gretta is a major character in Find Player Two!, the third story in Fazbear Frights 11: Prankster.

Gretta has short red curls, flawless pale skin, green eyes, and model-worthy features. She rarely wears makeup and cuts her own hair, which results in her curls being asymmetrical.
